ضَبْثَةٌ A grasp, or seizure. (O, TA.) [See also أَضْبَاثٌ.] ―
-b2- And الضَّبْثَةُ, (K,) or ضَبْثَةُ الأَسَدِ, (A, TA,) is the name of A certain brand, upon a camel, (A, K, TA,) in the form of a ring with some lines before and behind: (A, TA:) it is on the side of the thigh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
